subject.title: feat(ui): expand the Lobsterdex with 14 palettes, lore tooltips, and a collection page

question: Should users who previously completed the 14-palette Lobsterdex intentionally return to an incomplete 28-palette collection after this feature lands?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes a visible browser-local achievement outcome rather than merely adding optional presentation, so product intent determines whether the reset is acceptable or needs preservation logic.

options.title: Accept the expanded progression
options.body: Ship the 28-palette catalog and treat the new palettes as additional collection goals for every existing browser.

options.title: Preserve prior completion
options.body: Define a durable completion rule or migration so users who completed the original 14-palette collection retain a completed-state acknowledgment.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Land tooltip and browsing improvements without changing the existing collection threshold until the progression policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept the expanded progression
recommendation.body: Ship the 28-palette catalog and treat the new palettes as additional collection goals for every existing browser.

likelyOwner.reason: The author and assignee documented the intended progression reset and is the best available routing candidate from the supplied PR context.
